source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Σισίνιος ο Ιερομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3072/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Neither of the corpus's two Sisinnius folders is this man: `sisinnius-of-constantinople` is kept on the Greek 11 October and `sisinnius-of-milan` on 29 May, and this notice gives neither a see nor a city to match. The display name takes the day. The `hieromartyr` type is the page's own «ο Ιερομάρτυρας» and is confirmed by its couplet, which has him a sacrificer become a sacrifice; the page names no see, so no `office` is recorded. No year, no hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
